item.title: Residents threaten to move as 144-unit complex brings safety fears to accident-prone intersection
item.description: A 144-unit affordable housing development under construction near North Carefree Circle and Peterson Road has neighbors worried about increased traffic and pedestrian safety.

item.title: Boosting back up to the 50s and 60s on Wednesday with snow in the mountains
item.description: Eastern Colorado will feel a boost in temperatures on Wednesday, rising about 10 to 15 degrees above average. Meanwhile, snow will be ongoing in the high country.

item.title: Colorado Springs ice cream shop honors local Olympians with limited edition flavor
item.description: Colorado Springs ice cream shop honors local Olympians Ellie Kam and Danny O'Shea with limited edition flavor, portion of proceeds will benefit figure skating community
